verses.text: Why are the nations raging? Why are the peoples making plans that will come to nothing?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers plot together against the LORD and his Anointed One. They say,
“Let’s break their chains and throw off their ropes.”
The one enthroned in heaven laughs. The Lord makes fun of them.
Then he speaks to them in anger and terrifies them with his wrath:
“I’ve already set my King on Zion, my holy hill.”
I’ll tell you what the LORD declared to me: “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
Ask me, and I’ll give you the nations as your inheritance and the far ends of the earth as your own.
You’ll break them with an iron rod and smash them like a clay pot.”
So wise up, you kings. Take this warning, you judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with reverence and rejoice with trembling.
Honor the Son sincerely, or his anger may flare up and you’ll perish along the way. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
